items.caption: Small-seal-style 頁 is presented as a head-and-body graph: the head is emphasized, and this seal form is described as omitting hair found in some earlier forms.
items.alt: Black small-seal-style glyph with a broad enclosed upper section containing curved and horizontal white spaces, above a long, curving lower stroke.
items.selection_reason: The drawing is identified as a Shuowen seal-style form and illustrates the traditional graph discussed in the head-pictograph analysis.

limitations.text: This is a modern vector drawing of a historical script form, not an image of an ancient inscription.
